Apps / add

Add an app

An app comes from its deploy artifact: the package your pipeline publishes to the registry. shelf reads it, generates the secrets it declares, and keeps the app on that tag from then on.

Domain

Empty, it answers at <app>-dev.example.com, with its name in place of <app>. To reach it from the internet, the domain has to be a Cloudflare zone.

Registry login

A classic token with read:packages, for a private deploy artifact and private images on ghcr.io. Only this app uses it. Empty, the registry is read without a login.

Internet

With a token, the app gets a tunnel of its own in that account and a DNS record in its zone. The token needs Cloudflare Tunnel:Edit and DNS:Edit; the account is only needed when it sees several. It is kept on this machine, never in the cluster.
